indicator_name: Quasi-fiscal flows through the republican budget, year to date: budget loans and equity to development institutions and national holdings (Baiterek, DBK, IDF, Damu, ACC, Otbasy, Samruk-Kazyna, Problem Loans Fund …)
description: Квазифискальные операции через республиканский бюджет с начала года: бюджетные кредиты и взносы в уставный капитал институтов развития и нацхолдингов (Байтерек, БРК, ФРП, Даму, АКК, Отбасы, Самрук-Казына, ФПК …)
unit: million KZT, January to the month
methodology: Minfin Statistical Bulletin «табл 8 (расх)» (republican budget spending by programme), sections БЮДЖЕТНЫЕ КРЕДИТЫ (LOAN) and ПРИОБРЕТЕНИЕ ФИНАНСОВЫХ АКТИВОВ (EQUITY), every edition since 2013-01 (2013-2018 from the yearly archives, via scripts/backfill_minfin_bulletins.py --dims). Dated the first day of the period's last month; year to date (difference within a year for the month). Recipient read from the programme label, not the codes (codes change with reorganisations): the first entity named is the direct counterparty, the last one before «через» the final recipient; БРК-Лизинг = IDF. Items for SEC in LOAN, EQUITY: SEC (section total), SEC.DI (development institutions and holdings), SEC.<final recipient> (BAITEREK, DBK, IDF, DAMU, KAZAKHEXPORT, QIC, KAZAGRO, ACC, KAF, FCC, OTBASY, KHC, KMC, HCGF, KMGF, SAMRUK, KTZ, FPK), SEC.FAM.<DEV_FINANCE|SME|AGRI|HOUSING|SAMRUK|FPK>, SEC.VIA.<BAITEREK|KAZAGRO|SAMRUK> (direct counterparty), and the rest SEC.LOCAL_GOV, SEC.GUARANTEE_CALL, SEC.INTL_ORG, SEC.OTHER_QUASI, SEC.OTHER, so SEC = SEC.DI + the five; SEC.DI = sum of recipients = sum of families. Items that are zero in every edition are left out. Checked: programmes add up to the section header in every edition (hard check); headers = табл 7 except its known errors of 2021-02/03; LOAN.DI = табл 10 specifics 513+519 in every edition. December YTD LOAN.DI 2013-2025 (bn): 60.0, 58.9, 68.9, 182.5, 194.1, 146.5, 246.5, 245.2, 284.7, 577.3, 410.3, 274.0, 235.5. Out of scope: current transfers in the ЗАТРАТЫ section (217/202 FPK 2 092.9 bn in 2017, Даму subsidies 243/087), National Fund/NBK/UAPF purchases of holding bonds, local-budget lending (REGIONAL_BUDGETS_YTD NET_LENDING). Missing editions: 2020-04, 2026-04.
